fact: Tunisian Customs spokesman Chokri Jabri said on 12 October 2026 that customs is about to integrate AI to adapt risk-targeting criteria automatically and that first trials improved targeting quality by 20 to 25 percent, with AI also to analyse container-scanner images.
The GAINAfrica project (Horizon Europe, La Sapienza) is testing a multilingual mobile app for crop-disease identification and precision agriculture in Tunisia, per AIM.

The Direction Generale des Douanes officially integrated a machine-learning module into the national customs selectivity system to target high-risk customs declarations, per its 16 May 2026 communique.

Tunisian Customs said on 9 October 2026 that AI integrated into its risk-management and selectivity system should enter operation at the end of November 2026 to target high-risk declarations, per Colonel-Major Kais Ben Zayed.
A customs risk-identification learning model was simulated on 2025 data and found about 96.9 million dinars in additional amounts at a 49.23% detection rate, per the customs risk-management director.
The Director General of the National Customs School said the Sanad 2 system, designed to support risk targeting and certificates of origin in Customs, is among projects currently underway.

Minister Hemissi said his ministry, with the Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries ministry, has begun setting up a new version of the National Water Observatory giving real-time monitoring and short and medium-term forecasts, under the strategy's predictive-modelling priority for agriculture.
